scene: You climb the wooden ladder, reaching an open windy transit deck.
picture: Flat side-view across an elevated wooden transit platform. On the far left, a hillside chairlift dangles empty. Left of centre, the boy in his orange vest, white scarf, and kite steps off the tall ladder. In the centre sits a sleigh tram. On the far right floats a glass-bottomed boat.
shown: a swinging green two-seater chairlift on an overhead cable, far left, swaying gently
a striped sleigh-shaped tram on brass rails, centre right, with open doors
a glass-bottomed riverboat moored to a wooden dock on the far right
